claim: Goldman et al. studied patient-specific modulation of leukocyte response during dimethyl fumarate treatment in MS, including absolute lymphocyte count, absolute neutrophil count, and neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio.
future_grounding_route: Use as source-specific context for pre-specified cell-count and composition diagnostics in validation cohorts; do not treat as transcriptomic validation.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: V22 scalar is immune-tone bounded, not steroid/composition artifact

project_use: Sharper V50 source record for simple leukocyte-count composition diagnostics during DMF validation.
relationship_note: This source supports tracking basic leukocyte composition and ratio changes as validation diagnostics, but does not evaluate the V22 transcriptomic scalar.

source.citation: Goldman MD, Dwyer L, Coleman R, Sohn MW, Stuve O. Patient-specific factors modulate leukocyte response in dimethyl fumarate treated MS patients. PLOS ONE. 2020;15:e0228617.
source.label: Goldman 2020 DMF leukocyte response factors

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PLOS ONE article metadata; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only.

why_unverifiable: The project has not imported the clinical count data or evaluated it alongside the frozen validation harness.
